title: Luxury Condo w/ heated pool&parking
description:
Experience Nashville @ The Luxury Suite. This is a barn style 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom with a modern touch in the heart of downtown Nashville. This suite is conveniently located 2 minutes from music row surrounded by major attractions, including Bridgestone Arena, Country Music Hall of Fame, Nissan Stadium, Convention Center, Museum & more. The suite is perfect for families, couples & business travelers with many restaurants, bars & shopping in walking distance.y

The space
The Luxury Suite is designed to give you a high end & comfortable experience. The unique double barn doors gives privacy when closed & an open airy feeling when pushed open. The apartment has a queen bed, a convertible sofa and a high queen air mattress to allow for comfortable sleeping arrangements. Looking to kick back and stay in a couple days, we got you covered. Take advantage of some streaming with our Roku Smart TV which includes access to  Netflix, Hulu, Disney+, youtube, wifi and more. The kitchen is stocked with cookware if you desire to dine in. In need of some fun? We have a swimming pool with beautiful outdoor sitting and grilling areas available. For those who need to get fit, visit our 24 hour fitness center including a rock climbing wall and yoga studio. visit our 2 level lounge 24 hrs a day for some quiet study time, work or relaxation. There is a washer and dryer in the unit for your laundry needs. Lastly, the suite is thoroughly cleaned and sanitized immediately after check-out by our partnering company Meme Montheria Cleaning. We also include light cleaning supplies for your peace-of-mind.
